english.note: Use this when someone impresses by performing exceptionally well, especially in a game or public performance.
Use this when a person shines by performing exceptionally well.

examples.english: They did impress everyone by performing excellently in the game.
examples.traditional: 佢哋喺場波入面表現出色，贏晒全場掌聲。
